name: Tony Zickler
source: A maintenance soldier under Otto Strauss. Stationed at Bebersee Base. Tony Zickler is the maintenance soldier most often seen talking to Otto and working on the MiG-21PF, and likely the one Otto trusts most to not be a Stasi informant.
